entities.summary: Vantaa is a city in Finland. It is located to the north of the capital, Helsinki, in southern Uusimaa. The population of Vantaa is approximately 253,000. It is the 4th most populous municipality in Finland. Vantaa is part of the Helsinki Metropolitan Area, which has approximately 1.6 million inhabitants. Vantaa is a city in Northern Europe, established around 1428. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 97 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
